build.beforeDevCommand: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/frontend/package.json" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; exec npm --prefix "$d/frontend" run dev -- --host 127.0.0.1'
build.beforeBuildCommand: sh -c 'd=$PWD; while [ ! -f "$d/frontend/package.json" ] && [ "$d" != / ]; do d=$(dirname "$d"); done; npm --prefix "$d/frontend" run build'

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop Al-Quran reader with audio recitation and TTS translation
bundle.longDescription: eQuran is a desktop application for reading and listening to the Al-Quran with 6 qari options, Indonesian and English TTS translation, and offline caching.
